name: BDIX Repo for Nuvio
description: Bangladeshi BDIX FTP / media servers for Nuvio. Ported from the Niloy-Sarker/niloy-cloudstream and redowan99/Redowan-CloudStream CloudStream extensions.
author: nuvio-bdix-plugin

scrapers.name: Circle FTP (BDIX)
scrapers.description: Circle FTP BDIX server (new.circleftp.net). Movies, TV series, anime, Hindi/South/Korean. Only reachable on BDIX-connected ISPs in Bangladesh.
scrapers.author: nuvio-bdix-plugin

scrapers.name: DhakaFlix (BDIX)
scrapers.description: DhakaFlix h5ai servers 172.16.50.7/9/12/14. English, Hindi, South, Kolkata, Korean, anime and TV series. Only reachable on BDIX-connected ISPs.
scrapers.author: nuvio-bdix-plugin

scrapers.name: Dflix / Discovery FTP (BDIX)
scrapers.description: Discovery FTP (dflix.discoveryftp.net / movies.discoveryftp.net). Movies and series. Only reachable on BDIX-connected ISPs.
scrapers.author: nuvio-bdix-plugin

scrapers.name: FTPBD Emby (BDIX)
scrapers.description: FTPBD Emby server (media.ftpbd.net:8096) using the public guest account. Only reachable on BDIX-connected ISPs.
scrapers.author: nuvio-bdix-plugin

scrapers.name: RoarZone Emby (BDIX)
scrapers.description: RoarZone Emby server (play.roarzone.info) using the public guest account. Only reachable on BDIX-connected ISPs.
scrapers.author: nuvio-bdix-plugin

scrapers.name: FMFTP (BDIX)
scrapers.description: FMFTP (fmftp.net) movies and TV, matched by TMDB id. Only reachable on BDIX-connected ISPs.
scrapers.author: nuvio-bdix-plugin

scrapers.name: ICC FTP (BDIX)
scrapers.description: ICC FTP (10.16.100.244). Movies and series. Only reachable on ICC-connected ISPs.
scrapers.author: nuvio-bdix-plugin

scrapers.name: CTGMovies
scrapers.description: ctgmovies.com movies, TV and anime, matched by TMDB id; files served from ctgfun.com.
scrapers.author: nuvio-bdix-plugin
